title: Infrastructure
description: Host metrics from the collector and process metrics per service.

panels.title: Host CPU busy
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, 1 - avgIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'idle') AS busy
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
panels.description: Average of all non-idle CPU states

panels.title: Host CPU by state
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['state'] AS state,
  avg(Value) AS utilization
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.utilization' AND Attributes['state'] != 'idle' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, state ORDER BY time

panels.title: Host memory used
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, avg(Value) AS used
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'system.memory.utilization' AND Attributes['state'] = 'used' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Load average
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, replaceOne(MetricName, 'system.cpu.load_average.', '') AS window, avg(Value) AS load
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName LIKE 'system.cpu.load_average.%' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, window ORDER BY time

panels.title: Network throughput
panels.description: Rate computed from the cumulative system.network.io counter
panels.sql:
SELECT time, direction, (v - prev) / $__interval_s AS bytes_per_second
FROM (
  SELECT time, direction, v,
    lagInFrame(v, 1, v) OVER (PARTITION BY direction ORDER BY time ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS prev
  FROM (
    SELECT time, direction, sum(v) AS v FROM (
      SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, Attributes['device'] AS device,
        Attributes['direction'] AS direction, max(Value) AS v
      FROM otel_metrics_sum
      WHERE MetricName = 'system.network.io' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
      GROUP BY time, device, direction
    ) GROUP BY time, direction
  )
)
WHERE v >= prev
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Process memory by service
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName, avg(Value) AS memory
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'process.memory.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

panels.title: Process CPU by service
panels.sql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS time, ServiceName, avg(Value) AS cpu
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'process.cpu.utilization' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY time, ServiceName ORDER BY time

panels.title: Metric inventory
panels.sql:
SELECT * FROM (
  SELECT MetricName AS metric, 'gauge' AS type, any(MetricUnit) AS unit, uniqExact(ServiceName) AS services, count() AS points
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY metric
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MetricName, 'sum', any(MetricUnit), uniqExact(ServiceName), count()
  FROM otel_metrics_sum WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY MetricName
  UNION ALL
  SELECT MetricName, 'histogram', any(MetricUnit), uniqExact(ServiceName), count()
  FROM otel_metrics_histogram WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY MetricName
)
ORDER BY points DESC

panels.title: Data points by service
panels.sql:
SELECT if(ServiceName = '', 'collector (host)', ServiceName) AS service, count() AS points
FROM otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY service ORDER BY points DESC
